ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT is dated as of August I&,               635 Madison Avenue, New York, New York 10022 ("Gothic 96") and GOTHIC AMSTERDAM REALTY COMPANY, LLC, having an office c/o Essex Capital Partners, Ltd, WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Gothic 96 is the owner infee of a certain parcel described in Exhibit A-1 annexed hereto and made a part hereof, together with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as and by the street address 743Amsterdam Avenue,NewYork,NewYork and beingpart of Lot 1 of Block 1851 on the Tax Map of The City of New York (said land being herein called the "Gothic 96 Property" and said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to this Agreement, being called the “Existing Building"); and WHEREAS, Gothic Amsterdam is the owner in fee of a certain parcel described in Exhibit A-2 annexed hereto and made a part hereof, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as and by the street address 743 Amsterdam Avenue,NewYork,New York and being part of Lot 1 in Block 1851 on the Tax Map of the City of New York (said land being herein called the “Gothic Amsterdam Property"); and WHEREAS, the parties hereto desire that the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) shall be the property of Gothic Amsterdam; and WHEREAS,GothicAmsterdamandGothic96aresimultaneouslyherewith executing and delivering a Declaration of Restrictions, as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, in order to create a single zoning lot (the “Zoning Lot") of the Gothic 96 Property and the Gothic Amsterdam Property (said Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions, as same may hereafter be modified, amended or replaced, being referred to herein as the “Declaration"); and WHEREAS, Gothic Amsterdam may convey the Excess Development Rights to a third party and, at such time, combine the Zoning Lot with a new, enlarged zoning lot (such future lot, the “Merged Zoning Lot"); and WHEREAS, the parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Zoning Lot and such future Merged Zoning Lot. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the premises contained herein and other good and valuable consideration the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties hereby agree as follows: NY2:11552834\031X@6@03!.DOC40086.0003

SECTION1.DEFINITIONS (a)“Business Day” shall mean any day other than Saturday, Sunday or other day on which commercial banks are authorized to be closed inNewYorkState. (b)“Development Rights” shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a “zoning lot”", to develop the zoning lot by erecting thereona structure or structureswith a total“floor area"determined(i) bymultiplying the area of the zoning lot times the maximum allowable “floor area ratio" for structures in the zoning district or districts in which such zoning lot is located, and (ii) any available bonus floor area, bulk or density rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution and which may be authorized to be (c)“Excess Development Rights” shall mean those Development Rights in excess of those Floor Area Development Rights utilized by the Existing Building on the date hereof. It is agreed and acknowledged that as of the date hereof the Excess Development Rights consist of Seventy Five Thousand One Hundred Forty One square feet (75,141) of Floor Area. (d) “Property” shall mean the Gothic 96 Property and the Gothic Amsterdam Property, or any combination thereof, as the context may require. (e) Retained Development Rights” shall mean all of the Development Rights utilized by theExistingBuilding as of the date hereof.It is agreed and acknowledged that as of the date hereof the Retained Development Rights consist of Twenty Nine Thousand Four Hundred Sixty Seven square feet (29,467) of Floor Area. (f) “Violation” shall mean any violation of the Zoning Resolution or any building code, fire code, or other law, ordinance or regulation which would adversely affect the issuance of a temporary or permanent certificate of occupancy for any building located on the Merged Zoning Lot or the issuance of a building or other work permit required to build, rebuid, alter, repair or maintain any parcel that is part of the Merged Zoning Lot. (g) “Zoning Resolution" shall mean the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, effective as of December 15, 1961, as amended from time to time. Undefined terms used in this Agreement which are defined in the Zoning Resolution, including, without limitation, “Floor Area", “Floor Area Ratio", “Zoning Lot",“Parties in 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution.
